avis.titre: Keep Repurchasing - Wish I Could Get as Toner
avis.texte: I keep buying these toner pads over and over again. They really helped me out when I had an incident with a product that was supposed to help with ingrown hairs in the underarm area. The pads helped me with some hyperpigmentation and overall skin damage from the other product and helped even out the skin tone. They also really help in general with controlling under arm odor if you are also using natural deodorant or cycling between natural and antiperspirant. I’m going to try them on some other parts of my body that have some pigmentation issues. I wish I could just purchase as a toner so I could use my own pads - then there would be less plastic waste involved but I’ve not found a good alternative for these.

avis.titre: Essential product in your daily routine
avis.texte: I love this product!!!!!. A few month ago, I bought the Celimax One Step Brightening Body Pad after reading some good reviews online. I wanted something gentle but helpful to improve dark spots on my elbows and knees. I also hoped it would make my skin look brighter and more even. The product comes in a round container with pads soaked in the formula, so it’s easy to use. I liked the clean and simple packaging. Each pad has a rough side for light exfoliating and a smooth side for extra moisture. It contains niacinamide, which helps brighten the skin. The scent is soft and pleasant. After using the pads regularly for about three weeks, I saw that my skin looked smoother and healthier. The dark areas began to fade slowly. The pads were very gentle and didn’t cause any irritation, which is great because I have sensitive skin. Also, the price was fair, and the container lasted over a month. In general, I had a good experience with this product. It worked well and left my skin feeling fresh and clean. I would recommend it to anyone looking for a simple and effective skincare item to add to their daily routine. :)

I'm just about done with this and at first I was not seeing any difference in my underarms, but I have started to see them lightening up a bit. I can't say it takes the place of deodorant for me, but I do believe with consistent, daily use, you'll be able to see the area lighten up
